<?php
class C {const X=MISSING; public static int $p=1;}
echo "before";
echo C::$p;

<?php
class C {const X=MISSING; private static int $p=1;}
echo "before";
echo C::$p;

<?php
class A {const X=N; public static function f(){echo self::X; echo static::X;}}
class B extends A {const X=M;}
const N=1; const M=2;
$f=[B::class,"f"](...);
$f();
$g=clone $f;
$g();

<?php
class A {const X=N;}
const N=7;
function h($n,$m){echo A::X; return true;}
set_error_handler("h");
trigger_error("go",1024);

<?php
class C {const X=N; public static int $p=1;}
const N=1;
new C;
$a=[2];
C::$p =& $a[0];
echo C::$p;
$a[0]=3;
echo C::$p;

<?php
class C {const X=MISSING; public static int $p=1;}
echo "before";
unset(C::$p);

<?php
class A{const X=[N];}
const N=7;
function h($n,$m){echo A::X[0];return true;}
set_error_handler("h");
$v=1;$alias=&$v;
if($v===$missing){echo "eq";}else{echo "ne";}
echo A::X[0];

<?php
class C{const X=N;public static int $p=1;public static function &get(){return self::$p;}}
const N=2;
new C;
$r =& C::get();
$r=3;
echo C::$p,C::X;

<?php
class A { const Closure F = static function() { return self::class . ":" . static::class; }; }
class B extends A {}
$f=A::F; $g=B::F; $h=clone $f;
echo ($f === $g) ? "same:" : "bad:";
echo ($h === $f) ? "bad:" : "clone:";
echo $f(), ":", $h();

<?php
namespace { function globalfn() { echo "G"; } }
namespace N {
function localfn() { echo "L"; }
class A { const \Closure F=localfn(...); const \Closure G=globalfn(...); }
$f=A::F; $g=A::G; $h=clone $f;
echo ($f === A::F) ? "same:" : "bad:";
$f(); $g(); echo ":"; $h();
}

<?php
class A { public static function f() { return self::class . ":" . static::class; } }
class B extends A { const Closure F=B::f(...); }
class C extends B {}
$f=C::F; $g=B::F; $h=clone $f;
echo ($f === $g) ? "same:" : "bad:";
echo $f(), ":", $h();

<?php
class A { private static function f() { return "private"; } const Closure F=self::f(...); }
class B extends A {}
$f=B::F; echo $f();

<?php
class A { const Closure F=late(...); }
try { $f=A::F; } catch (Error $e) { echo "retry:"; }
if (true) { function late() { return "ok"; } }
$f=A::F; echo $f(); echo ($f === A::F) ? ":same" : ":bad";

<?php
class A { const array F=[static function() { return "v"; }]; }
$a=A::F; $b=A::F;
echo ($a[0] === $b[0]) ? "same:" : "bad:";
$a[0]=clone $a[0];
echo ($a[0] === $b[0]) ? "bad:" : "clone:";
echo $a[0](), $b[0]();

<?php
class A { const Closure F=static function() { static $n=0; echo ++$n; }; }
class B extends A {}
$f=A::F; $g=B::F;
$f(); $g();
$h=clone $f;
$h(); $f(); $h(); $g();

<?php
namespace { function f() { echo "G"; } }
namespace N {
class A { const \Closure F=f(...); }
$first=A::F;
if (true) { function f() { echo "L"; } }
$second=A::F;
echo ($first === $second) ? "same:" : "bad:";
$first(); $second(); echo ":";
$fresh=f(...); $fresh();
}

<?php
namespace { function f() { echo "G"; } }
namespace N {
class A { const array X=[f(...),LATE]; }
try { $v=A::X; } catch (\Error $e) { echo "retry:"; }
if (true) { function f() { echo "L"; } }
const LATE=1;
$v=A::X; $w=A::X;
echo $v[1], ":";
($v[0])(); ($w[0])(); echo ":";
$fresh=f(...); $fresh();
}

<?php
namespace { function globalfn() { echo "G"; } }
namespace N {
function localfn() { echo "L"; }
class A { const Closure F=localfn(...); const Closure G=globalfn(...); }
$f=A::F; $g=A::G; $h=clone $f;
echo ($f === A::F) ? "same:" : "bad:";
$f(); $g(); echo ":"; $h();
}

<?php

echo "unreached";

<?php
$x=1;
class A { const F=static function() use ($x) {}; }
echo "unreached";

<?php

<?php

<?php
class A {
    const \Closure F = static function() { echo "A"; };
    const array X = [static function() { echo "B"; }, static function() { echo "C"; }];
}
class B extends A {
    const \Closure G = parent::F;
    const array Y = [parent::F, self::G];
}
$f=A::F; $g=B::G; $x=A::X; $y=B::Y;
echo ($f === $g && $y[0] === $f && $y[1] === $f) ? "same:" : "bad:";
echo ($x[0] !== $x[1]) ? "distinct:" : "bad:";
$x[0]=$x[1];
($x[0])(); echo ":";
(A::X[0])(); (A::X[1])(); $g();

<?php
namespace {
class A { public static function f() { return self::class . ":" . static::class; } }
class B extends A {}
}
namespace N {
class A { public static function f() { return "wrong"; } }
class B extends A {}
class C { const \Closure F=('B')::f(...); const \Closure G=('\B')::f(...); }
class D extends C {}
$f=C::F; $g=D::F; $h=clone $f; $q=C::G;
echo ($f === $g) ? "same:" : "bad:";
echo $f(), ":", $h(), ":", $q();
}

<?php
class A { const X=('self')::f(...); }

<?php
class A { const X=('\parent')::f(...); }

<?php
class A { const X=('STaTiC')::f(...); }

<?php

<?php

<?php

<?php
class A {
    const Closure H = static function($level, $message, $file, $line) {
        static $count = 0;
        echo ++$count;
        $GLOBALS['missing'] = 1;
        return true;
    };
}
$h = A::H;
set_error_handler($h);
echo (false || $missing) ? "bad" : "null";
echo ":", (A::H === $h) ? "same:" : "bad:";
$h(1024, "again", "file", 7);

<?php
namespace N;
use Vendor\MiXeD as Alias;
use Vendor\Pkg as Pkg;

    const string S = self::class;

    const string D = self::class . LATE;

}
class B extends A {}
const LATE = "!";
echo B::S, ":", B::P, ":";
B::f(); echo ":"; B::g();
echo ":", A::$s, ":", (new B)->i, ":", B::D, ":", A::D;

<?php

echo X;

f();

<?php
class Root {}
class A extends Root { public static function run() { eval('const INNER = [self::class, parent::class];'); } }
class B extends A {}
B::run();
echo INNER[0], ":", INNER[1];

<?php
class Root {}
class A extends rOoT {
    const string P = parent::class;
    const Closure F = static function($x = parent::class) { echo $x; };
}
class B extends A {}
$f = A::F;
echo A::P, ":"; $f(); echo ":";
$g = $f->bindTo(null, B::class);
$g(); echo ":"; $f();

<?php
namespace { class Root {} }
namespace N {
    class A extends \Root {
        const string X = ('Ghost')::class;
        const string Y = ('\Ghost')::class;
        const string S = ('self')::class;
        const string P = ('parent')::class;
        const string FS = \self::class;
        const string FP = \parent::class;
    }
    echo A::X, ":", A::Y, ":", A::S, ":", A::P, ":", A::FS, ":", A::FP;
}

<?php
class A { const X = ('Ghost' . 'Name')::class; }
echo A::X;

<?php
class A { const X = (123)::class; }
echo A::X;

<?php
class A { const X = ('static')::class; }
echo A::X;

<?php
namespace { class Root {} }
namespace N {
class A extends \rOoT {
    public static function f() {
        echo self::class, '|', \self::class, '|', namespace\self::class, '|', ('self')::class, '|',
            parent::class, '|', \parent::class, '|', namespace\parent::class, '|', ('parent')::class;
    }
}
A::f();
}

<?php
namespace { class Root {} }
namespace N {
class A extends \rOoT {
    public static function make() {
        return static function () {
            echo self::class, '|', \self::class, '|', namespace\self::class, '|', ('self')::class, '|',
                parent::class, '|', \parent::class, '|', namespace\parent::class, '|', ('parent')::class;
        };
    }
}
class B extends A {}
$f = A::make();
$f(); echo ';';
$g = $f->bindTo(null, B::class);
$g(); echo ';';
$f();
}

<?php
class A { const Closure H = static function($x=self::class) { return $x; }; }
class B extends A {}
class S {
    public function __toString(): string {
        $f=A::H;
        $g=$f->bindTo(null, B::class);
        return $g() . ":" . $f() . ":" . ((A::H === $f) ? "same" : "bad");
    }
}
function take(string $x) { echo $x; }
take(new S);
